title: IntentRequest
description: Standardized request envelope for dispatching intents across the Tandem L7 mesh.

request_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 or deterministic identifier for correlation.

target_capability.description: Dot-delimited name of target capability to execute.

params.description: Key-value argument payload conforming to target capability schema.

caller_taint.description: Information-flow trust level of caller or input payload.

timestamp_sec.description: Unix timestamp in epoch seconds when request was formulated.

ratified_by_hand.description: Whether elevated blast-radius action was physically ratified by operator.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace context ID for multi-hop workflow tracking.
